def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    visited = set()
    path = []

    def is_valid(row, col):
        return 0 <= row < rows and 0 <= col < cols and grid[row][col] == '.' and (row, col) not in visited

    def find_path(row, col):
        if (row, col) == goal:
            path.append((row, col))
            return True

        if not is_valid(row, col):
            return False

        visited.add((row, col))
        path.append((row, col))

        # Explore neighbors
        if find_path(row + 1, col) or \
           find_path(row - 1, col) or \
           find_path(row, col + 1) or \
           find_path(row, col - 1):
            return True

        # Backtrack
        path.pop()
        return False

    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    if find_path(start[0], start[1]):
        return path
    else:
        return []

    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    
    q = [(start, [start])]
    visited = set()
    
    while q:
        (row, col), path = q.pop(0)
        
        if (row, col) == goal:
            return path
        
        visited.add((row, col))
        
        for dr, dc in [(0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)]:
            new_row, new_col = row + dr, col + dc
            
            if 0 <= new_row < rows and 0 <= new_col < cols and \
               grid[new_row][new_col] == '.' and (new_row, new_col) not in visited:
                q.append(((new_row, new_col), path + [(new_row, new_col)]))
                
    return []

            if (0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and
                    grid[r][c] == '.' and (r, c) not in visited):
                queue.append(((r, c), path + [(r, c)]))

                grid[new_row][new_col] == '.' and (new_row, new_col) not in visited):
                queue.append(((new_row, new_col), path + [(new_row, new_col)]))

        path.pop()
        return False

    if not is_valid(start[0], start[1]) or not is_valid(goal[0], goal[1]):
        return []

    if start == goal and grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.':
        return [start]

    if find_path(start[0], start[1]):
        return path
    else:
        return []
